_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: F&G ~50, 30d mild negative, flat funding and absent ETF flows describe coil/drift one rung up into Complacency, not a breakout or flush.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency; narrative has no forward phase call (inflow fact only), so agreement is only on non-aggressive stance
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds 45-55 and 30d momentum stays inside ±5% with ETF flows still absent and funding near flat
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear & Greed breaks under 40 with 30d momentum under -8% (flush), or ETF flows reverse and Fear & Greed clears 62 (Disbelief/Hope)
